target_population: outcome_blind accepted strict-indirect proposals under the existing Q-common-admitted proposal builder; not unconditional Research C population
generator: committed Research C step4c1 proposal, SCM, observation, and G0 corruption functions
task: outcome-blind strict indirect task from accepted proposal
learner: existing Ridge alpha=1.0 and fixed k grid {-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1}
objective_primary: gamma=0 standardized analytic true-SCM decision regret

development.selection: all admitted strict-indirect proposals; no outcome-based selection

confirmation.primary: T5_GUIDED_M4 minus FROZEN_M4 regret, B=1, gamma=0; negative favors T5
confirmation.sample_size_rule: fixed maximum 160; no outcome-dependent expansion or replacement

resources.resume: no replacement; preserve completed generated units and state; do not retry generation after outcome access

information_boundary: Recommendation and graph manifests are sealed before analytic truth response is queried; repair policy has no truth-outcome input.
public_data: aggregate only; unit inputs, recommendations, evaluation rows and fitted objects remain outside Git
